summary: Tested the new Manage PDF feature end-to-end. Backend: 14/15 pytest tests PASS for /api/pdf/* (create, render PNG, add-text, whiteout, add-image, page-op rotate/delete/insert-blank/reorder, merge, split-zip, download, save-to-documents, delete, RBAC 404). 1 SKIPPED (DOCX) due to missing LibreOffice in the runtime container -- this is a real backend issue: posting a .docx returns HTTP 500 with FileNotFoundError: 'soffice'. Frontend: sidebar nav-manage-pdf is present and routes to /manage-pdf; empty uploader and full workspace view work; upload of a 3-page PDF transitions to workspace, thumbnails render, insert-blank grows page count (3->4), rotate triggers a refresh, delete with confirm reduces count (4->3). Editor tab opens with Text/Image/Whiteout tools, canvas visible. Tabs (Pages/Editor/Merge/Split) all present with correct testids; Save-to-Documents button visible and previous runs created envelopes named 'sample (Edited)' visible on /documents. Regression smoke OK for /dashboard, /templates, /reports, /settings.

critical.issue: Returns 500 because LibreOffice ('soffice') is not installed in the container; pdf_service.convert_docx_to_pdf_bytes raises FileNotFoundError that is not caught. Either install libreoffice in the runtime image or wrap subprocess.run in try/except FileNotFoundError and return HTTPException(503, 'Word conversion unavailable, please upload PDF').

issues: Page header shows 'Manage PDF' but the actions slot (Download / Save to Documents) only appears once a workspace is loaded -- consistent with intent, just noting that the empty state has no theme toggle hidden behind it; toggle is reachable from AppShell header (data-testid='theme-toggle' = 1 confirmed).

action_items: HIGH: Make DOCX upload not crash with 500 when LibreOffice missing. Either install LibreOffice in the deployment image OR catch FileNotFoundError in pdf_service.convert_docx_to_pdf_bytes and raise HTTPException(503, 'Word conversion unavailable in this environment'). Same code path is also used by POST /api/pdf/workspace/{id}/merge with a .docx file -> will also 500.

OPTIONAL: text dialog playwright timing -- the dialog opens on onMouseDown; high-load page may need a wait_for_load_state('networkidle') after switching to editor tab before clicking the canvas. Functional code looks correct.
critical_code_review_comments: pdf_manager.py is ~460 lines, cleanly organised; good. Coordinates use fractional 0..1 with top-left origin consistently. Good.

convert_docx_to_pdf_bytes raises a bare RuntimeError on non-zero return code, but FileNotFoundError (missing soffice binary) bubbles up uncaught -> 500. Catch and convert to a meaningful HTTPException.
_save_workspace_pdf uses find_one_and_update with return_document=False to fetch the old file_id; this returns the PRE-update document. Good pattern.
/api/pdf/workspace/{id}/split parses ranges with _parse_ranges which validates bounds and rejects bad input with 400. Good.
RBAC enforced via _get_workspace filter {workspace_id, owner_id}: non-owner gets 404 (not 403). Acceptable but consider 403 for clarity.
Frontend ManagePdf.jsx is ~760 lines -- borderline; consider splitting SortablePageCard, PageEditor, and ToolBtn into separate component files for maintainability.
ManagePdf.jsx onMouseDown handles TEXT click directly -- works but a single-click on a non-empty existing pending point will replace position; minor UX nit.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all primary flows + sidebar verified; text-dialog timing issue is in playwright script, not the app)

seed_data_creation: Each test creates a workspace from a fitz-generated 3-page A4 PDF and deletes it in teardown. test_save_to_documents creates one envelope ('sample (Edited)') in user's documents -- cleaned up by the test, but earlier FE runs left a couple visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend /api/pdf endpoints work for PDF input. DOCX input hits FileNotFoundError because soffice/libreoffice is not installed in /app container. If LibreOffice gets installed, re-run test_docx_conversion (it will un-skip and assert). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_manager.py. The frontend Manage PDF page is fully wired and the integration with backend works end-to-end. The user account is on a 'free' plan and currently OVER quota (6/5) -- this does NOT affect /api/pdf/* endpoints, but if a future test calls POST /api/envelopes directly with a fresh file, it may hit 402; save-to-documents endpoint bypasses the quota check, which is fine.
rca_of_issue: Backend DOCX 500: pdf_service.convert_docx_to_pdf_bytes shells out to `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf`. The container has no LibreOffice -> subprocess.run raises FileNotFoundError which is not caught -> FastAPI returns 500 Internal Server Error with no detail. Mitigation 1 (preferred): apt-get install libreoffice in the deployment Dockerfile. Mitigation 2: in convert_docx_to_pdf_bytes, wrap subprocess.run in try/except FileNotFoundError and raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='Word conversion is not available on this server. Please upload a PDF instead.'). The same path is hit by POST /api/pdf/workspace AND POST /api/pdf/workspace/{id}/merge when a .docx is provided.
